items.headline: S&P kept Oracle investment grade despite negative free cash flow and record CDS spreads
items.note: Analysis argues S&P's BBB- call is inconsistent with its own numbers (debt +412% vs. interest costs +271% through 2028, FCF negative 2025-2027) while Oracle's 5-year CDS trades above 200bp, levels last seen in 2008 — keeps the junk-downgrade tail risk live.

items.headline: CoreWeave shares drop ~7% after surprise $3B convertible note and share sale to shore up balance sheet
items.note: CoreWeave priced $3B of convertible senior notes (option for $500M more) plus a 35M-share ATM equity program, explicitly framed as migrating its credit profile toward investment grade — a dilutive scramble for balance-sheet flexibility that the market read as a stress signal despite the company also touting $25B in new customer commitments.
